correctness.rationale: Exhaustive program covers every L=5,...,36, every two-star position pair satisfying a rigorously necessary 32-window-weight identity, and all assignments of remaining symbols. Full regenerated 1328-word list and independent direct-target Python checks passed; all 332 four-element symmetry orbits reconstructed. The finite proof is complete for order five, not extrapolated.

value.rationale: The foundational paper displays examples but does not resolve the natural enumeration question; an accessible follow-up explicitly asks to count upwords. This complete first rich binary order-five two-wildcard census determines every solution, all attainable lengths, and exact symmetry quotient, rather than an arbitrary isolated increment. It gives a concrete benchmark for enumeration algorithms and structural restrictions and does not pretend to be a theorem for all orders.
